page.overview:
Who is Dahlia?

Dahlia is a female Earth pony and supporting character in the My Little Pony Generation 5 film My Little Pony: A New Generation and subsequent Generation 5 media. She is a resident of the seaside Earth pony town of Maretime Bay, working there as a flower seller and baker.

Dahlia's name is similar to the G1 Earth pony Dainty Dahlia and the G3 Earth pony Darling Dahlia.

In the film My Little Pony: A New Generation, Dahlia appears as a resident of Maretime Bay, first appearing walking through town during Gonna Be My Day and later greeting town sheriff Hitch Trailblazer outside the Canterlogic factory. She later watches Phyllis Cloverleaf's technological presentation and flees in fear when Izzy Moonbow enters the town. Later in the film, she looks to deputy sheriff Sprout for leadership and safety against the "threat" of Pegasi and unicorns, and she joins the angry Earth pony mob during Danger, Danger. Dahlia appears again toward the end of the film after Pegasi and unicorns get their magic back.

In the hour-long special My Little Pony: Make Your Mark, Dahlia appears several times walking through Maretime Bay. When Posey rallies Earth ponies against Pegasi and unicorns, Dahlia joins her in shunning the other pony races from Maretime Bay Day. Toward the end of the special, when the pony races make amends, Dahlia and her fellow Earth ponies gain plant-growing magic.
